name: join-outer-preservation
description: Measure LEFT, RIGHT and FULL join preservation with nonnull projections

queries.name: left-outer
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, a.country FROM events e LEFT JOIN accounts a ON e.user_id = a.user_id ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 20

queries.name: right-outer
queries.sql: SELECT a.user_id, a.tier FROM events e RIGHT JOIN accounts a ON e.user_id = a.user_id ORDER BY a.user_id LIMIT 20

queries.name: full-outer
queries.sql: SELECT a.user_id, a.country FROM events e FULL JOIN accounts a ON e.user_id = a.user_id ORDER BY a.user_id LIMIT 20
